# TRL-VAR-0018: Variable name contains a hyphen

- Severity: warning
- Exit class: none
- Area: VAR
- Since: 0.1.0
- Status: active
- Fidelity: approximated

## Remediation

Microsoft restricts variable names to letters, numbers, periods and underscores, but its own variable-group example uses hyphenated names; the name is accepted, so verify it on a live run or rename it.

## Example

```json
{"code": "TRL-VAR-0018", "severity": "warning", "params": {"name": "<name>"}}
```
